trace.final:
All done. Summary:

- **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rolled back**: Rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all regions. Verified the service is now healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0002** (SEV2) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback remediation; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the first incident-creation attempt timed out, so I confirmed via the incident list that nothing was created, then retried with an idempotency key to avoid double-paging on-call. Recommended follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 failure before attempting to redeploy it.
